summary: Iteration 70: Geographic Filters and Distance Fix - ALL TESTS PASSED. Backend tests (13/13) verified admin/atletas returns estado/cidade fields and raio-x/completo returns distancia_total_km > 0. Frontend tests verified geographic filters in Admin > Atletas page with data-testid attributes, filtering functionality, and Limpar button.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Geographic filters in Admin > Atletas page fully functional. Estado filter (data-testid='atletas-filtro-estado') and Cidade filter (data-testid='atletas-filtro-cidade') work correctly. Selecting SP filters from 449 to 53 atletas. Cidade dropdown populates with SP cities (Campinas, Ribeirão Preto, Santos, Sorocaba, São Paulo). Limpar button resets filters. Backend raio-x/completo returns distancia_total_km > 0 (51.1 km for test user).

backend_admin_atletas_geo_fields.details: GET /api/admin/atletas?limit=1000 returns atletas with estado and cidade fields. 53 atletas from SP verified.

backend_raio_x_distancia_fix.details: GET /api/raio-x/completo returns evolucao.totais.distancia_total_km = 51.1 km for test user (teste.dono@teste.com). extrair_distancia function working correctly.

frontend_estado_filter_functionality.details: Selecting SP state filters atletas from 449 to 53. All Brazilian states available in dropdown.

frontend_cidade_filter_functionality.details: Cidade dropdown populates with cities from selected state. SP cities: Campinas, Ribeirão Preto, Santos, Sorocaba, São Paulo.

frontend_limpar_button.details: Limpar button appears when filters are active and resets geographic filters when clicked.

frontend_atletas_count.details: Badge shows correct count: 449 atletas (unfiltered), 53 atletas (filtered by SP).

admin_dashboard_compilation.details: Admin Dashboard compiles without errors. Only ESLint warnings for useEffect dependencies (pre-existing).
